nodes.description: address internal owner in BotProtected; set to tx.origin in ROBOSHIB constructor, used as privileged access gate.
address internal botProtection; external contract invoked via low-level call in the checkBots modifier, distribute and list.
address public uniPair; computed in the ROBOSHIB constructor via pairForPancake and passed to botProtection.call.
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token ledger mutated in transferFrom, distribute and list.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; approvals written in approve/constructor and decremented in transferFrom.
uint public totalSupply initialized to 1e30; used in list to compute owner allocation.
IUniswapV2Router02 public pancakeRouter; external router used by list (addLiquidityETH).
address public wrappedEther; WETH address used to derive the pair in the constructor.
uint constant public decimals = 18.
string public name = "ROBOSHIB".
string public symbol = "ROBOSHIB".
modifier checkBots(_from,_to,_value): performs an unguarded external call to botProtection and requires success; wraps transferFrom.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable returns (bool); forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable, guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic and emits Transfer.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to arbitrary address a with arbitrary calldata b.
pairForPancake(address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; derives a deterministic pair address via keccak256.
distribute(address[] memory _reallyGoHere, uint amount) public; owner-only, calls botProtection then overwrites balances of arbitrary addresses.

list(uint _numList, address[] memory _reallyGoHere, uint[] memory _amounts) public payable; owner-only, sets balances, calls addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline, then calls botProtection and distributes amounts.
constructor(address _botProtection) of BotProtected; stores botProtection.
constructor(address _botProtection) of ROBOSHIB; sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b) internal pure; overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b) internal pure; underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b) internal pure; overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b) internal pure; division by zero check.
msg.sender; attacker-controllable caller used for allowance checks, owner checks and address indexing.
tx.origin; used to set owner and to grant infinite allowance to the pair.
block.timestamp; used as the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
botProtection.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141,...)) inside checkBots; arbitrary external call executed before state changes, enabling reentrancy.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate; arbitrary delegatecall executing untrusted code in the contract's storage context.
botProtection.call(...) inside distribute; arbitrary external call made by owner-controlled flow.
botProtection.call(...) inside list; arbitrary external call after liquidity provision.
pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...); external call to a router with token approval and deadline derived from block.timestamp.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction (Solidity 0.7) that can underflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction on the ledger.
balanceOf[_to] += _value; raw unchecked addition on the ledger.

edges.reason: transfer forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value parameter into transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom.
checkBots forwards _from into the arbitrary botProtection.call payload.
checkBots forwards _to into the arbitrary botProtection.call payload.
checkBots forwards _value into the arbitrary botProtection.call payload.
botProtection state address is the target of the low-level call in checkBots.
uniPair state variable is encoded into the botProtection.call in checkBots.
External call executed before the transferFrom state updates allows re-entry into transferFrom.
_from indexes the allowance mapping decremented by _value.
msg.sender indexes the spender slot of the allowance decrement.
_value is subtracted from the caller allowance without SafeMath.
allowance state is read and mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
_from indexes the sender balance decremented by _value.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
balanceOf state mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
_to indexes the recipient balance incremented by _value.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
balanceOf state mapping is mutated by the unchecked addition.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the _spender parameter.
msg.sender is the owner index of the allowance write in approve.
approve stores the _value parameter into the allowance mapping.
delegate checks msg.sender against owner before delegating.
owner state variable is the authorization reference in delegate.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the untrusted calldata executed via delegatecall.
delegatecall success flag is captured in the local variable success.
Arbitrary delegatecall can re-enter or hijack control flow of the contract.
distribute requires msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable is the authorization reference in distribute.
_reallyGoHere is passed into the arbitrary botProtection.call in distribute.
botProtection is the call target in distribute.
distribute overwrites balanceOf[_reallyGoHere[i]] with amount.
amount parameter is written directly into arbitrary balances.
Loop index i controls which balance entries are overwritten in distribute.
list requires msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable is the authorization reference in list.
_numList is assigned to balanceOf[address(this)] and used as the liquidity amount.
_amounts array values are written into balanceOf in the final distribution loop.
_reallyGoHere addresses are written into balanceOf in list.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is assigned to balanceOf[msg.sender] in list.
_numList is passed as amountTokenDesired/amountTokenMin to addLiquidityETH.
pancakeRouter state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH external call.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
_reallyGoHere is passed into the arbitrary botProtection.call in list.
botProtection is the call target in list.
list depends on block.timestamp for the liquidity deadline.
External router call inside list can re-enter the contract before the distribution loop completes.
BotProtected constructor stores its _botProtection parameter into botProtection.
ROBOSHIB constructor forwards its _botProtection parameter to the BotProtected constructor.
owner is set to tx.origin, tying privileged access to the originating EOA.
wrappedEther is passed as a token argument into pairForPancake.
pairForPancake result is stored into the uniPair state variable.
tx.origin is granted an infinite allowance on uniPair in the constructor.
pancakeRouter is granted infinite allowance over the contract's own tokens.
Parameter tokenA is sorted and hashed inside pairForPancake.
Parameter tokenB is sorted and hashed inside pairForPancake.
pairForPancake assigns the derived address to its local variable pair.
